summary.text: The Battle for the Mirari was a catastrophic conflict on Otaria in Dominaria's Rift Era centered on the artifact the Mirari.

bio.text: A century after the Invasion the Mirari appeared and started wars that devastated the continent.
Empress Llawan lured Laquatus and his army into a chasm under false pretenses and sealed them in with portals at each end.
Turg ate a Krosan dragonette, whose call drew a full-grown dragon to devastate Cabal City.
Cabal City was destroyed and abandoned during the battle.

status.text: The conflict ended with the Mirari in Kamahl's hands, after Cabal City had been destroyed and abandoned.
